meta.name: doc-governance-init
meta.description: Bootstrap or refactor a repository's documentation into a layered governance structure that supports human readers and multiple coding agents (Claude, Codex, OpenCode) without tool lock-in.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为仓库搭建分层文档治理结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果仓库文档混乱，需要同时服务人类和多个AI编码助手。
copy.tagline_en: Bootstrap layered documentation governance for your repo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your repo docs are messy and need to serve both humans and multiple coding agents.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析仓库文档，将其重组为五层结构（README、AGENTS.md、docs/、agents/、prompts/），并生成迁移计划和维护规则。
howto.when: 当你要求“设置文档”、“组织文档”或“创建 AGENTS.md”，或者需要为新仓库引导文档、重构散乱文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个新项目建立文档治理结构。
say.note: Claude 会执行评估、规范化、迁移和治理四个阶段。

say.text: 重构现有文档，按五层模型组织。
say.note: Claude 会分析当前文档并生成迁移计划。

say.text: 创建 AGENTS.md 并设置协作规则。
say.note: Claude 会生成 AGENTS.md 并添加维护规则。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes repository documentation and restructures it into a five-layer system (README, AGENTS.md, docs/, agents/, prompts/), generating a migration plan and governance rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "set up docs", "organize documentation", or "create AGENTS.md", or when bootstrapping docs for a new repo or refactoring scattered docs.

say_en.text: Set up documentation governance for this new project.
say_en.note: Claude runs assessment, normalization, migration, and governance phases.

say_en.text: Refactor existing docs into the five-layer model.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes current docs and produces a migration plan.
Claude generates AGENTS.md and adds maintenance rules.
